req.title: Return 404 for unknown squadNumber
req.statement: The system shall return HTTP 404 when no player has the requested squad number.

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-005 requires HTTP 404 when no player has the requested squad number. The test suite covers: (1) a positive case confirming a known squad number returns 200 (proving the 404 path is conditional, not universal — kills mutations that always return 404); (2) a negative/EP case confirming a squad number that does not exist in the 26-row fixture returns exactly 404; (3) a BVA boundary case at squad number 27 (one above the highest seeded value of 26) returns 404; (4) a BVA boundary case at squad number 0 (one below the lowest seeded value of 1) returns 404; (5) a DT case using a large out-of-range number to confirm the 404 is not limited to near-boundary values. Together these kill status-code constant mutations (404->200, 404->400, 404->500), comparison-operator mutations in the service layer (None check), and off-by-one mutations around the boundary squad numbers.

preconditions: Database is pre-loaded with 26 rows; squad number 10 exists (Kabir Mary Reddy)
trace: R-PLAYER-005: 404 must only fire when no player has the squad number; a known number must return 200 — kills mutations that always return 404
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

def test_known_squad_number_returns_200_not_404():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r = client.get('/players/squadnumber/10')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert body['squadNumber'] == 10
    assert body['firstName'] == 'Kabir'
    assert body['lastName'] == 'Reddy'

test_known_squad_number_returns_200_not_404()

tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

def test_unknown_squad_number_returns_404():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r = client.get('/players/squadnumber/999')
    assert r.status_code == 404
    # Confirm it is not accidentally 200, 400, or 500
    assert r.status_code != 200
    assert r.status_code != 400
    assert r.status_code != 500

test_unknown_squad_number_returns_404()

tests.name: test_large_unknown_squad_number_returns_404
preconditions: Database is pre-loaded with 26 rows; squad number 100000 does not exist
expected: Response body is valid JSON (FastAPI default detail structure)
trace: R-PLAYER-005: DT — decision table row: player_found=False => 404; large value confirms the 404 path is not restricted to near-boundary inputs; kills mutations that short-circuit the not-found branch
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

def test_large_unknown_squad_number_returns_404():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r = client.get('/players/squadnumber/100000')
    assert r.status_code == 404
    # FastAPI raises HTTPException with no detail for this path;
    # response must still be parseable JSON
    body = r.json()
    assert isinstance(body, dict)

test_large_unknown_squad_number_returns_404()

tests.name: test_adjacent_existing_squad_numbers_do_not_return_404
preconditions: Database is pre-loaded with 26 rows; squad numbers 25 and 26 both exist
trace: R-PLAYER-005: BVA — confirms the two highest seeded squad numbers return 200, proving the 404 guard does not fire for valid boundary values; kills mutations that widen the 404 condition
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

def test_adjacent_existing_squad_numbers_do_not_return_404():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r25 = client.get('/players/squadnumber/25')
    assert r25.status_code == 200
    assert r25.json()['squadNumber'] == 25

    r26 = client.get('/players/squadnumber/26')
    assert r26.status_code == 200
    assert r26.json()['squadNumber'] == 26

test_adjacent_existing_squad_numbers_do_not_return_404()
